Having superhuman physiology expected of a metahuman, Aurelia is particularly good at swift, springy, and precise hops capable of covering absurd distances in a single bound. Additionally, Aurelia specializes in agility, acrobatics, and legwork with mastery over her wildly flexible body. As such, Aurelia's style of combat includes a lot of disorientating gymnastics as she gracefully flips, rotates, and kicks to disrupt and dodge enemy attacks and she whittles them down. Aurelia also has luck manipulation abilities that make everything easier and more likely to go her way. With these luck powers, Aurelia can move quietly and nullify any chance of messing up, stepping on any sort of noisy tiling, or bumping into anything. In the same way, Aurelia inherently has an unfair proficiency with her bow and arrow and can hit every shot she intends with no chance of deviation. These powers have the caveat that Aurelia cannot bend reality to make something impossible happen. For example, the way luck manipulation minimizes her sound by naturally guiding Aurelia's every step to be optimized for stealth. Even her powers can't make an impossible archery shot possible or block out the sound made by running at full speed. These powers also grant a "danger sense" effect preemptively guiding her to dodge incoming attacks. Finally, Aurelia has multiple types of trick arrows.

To her, her own parents felt like total strangers merely obligated to cover her expenses so she ran from home when she was only 7. Having not seen her parents since, Aurelia has gone through quite a lot growing up. Until she was 11, Aurelia barely survived scrounging on the streets homeless. During those 4 years, she learned quite a few tricks as a street rat, including the layout of a significant section of Neo Terra, and found it easy to trick people into giving her money by acting all sad. Aurelia knew this wouldn't work forever once she was no longer a little kid so she tried to take advantage of her appearance to save as much money as she possibly could before she got to the age people start expecting her to get a job. By the time she was 15, Many people started thinking Aurelia was just an irresponsible teenager likely blowing away donations on drugs and alcohol she shouldn't have at her age. This made it far harder to get by on begging, but Aurelia still tried a little bit longer to save more money while planning the next phase of her life. Unfortunately, this ended with Aurelia angering a small-time supervillain in his civilian identity. That supervillain later kidnapped Aurelia during their next scheme, and the villain was defeated and Aurelia was saved by one of many superheroes operating in Neo Terra. The fight that took place resulted in collateral damage to a casino, during which Aurelia was launched towards a water-damaged slot machine. The moment Aurelia was electrocuted, the superhero used his cosmic-based power to protect Aurelia in a thin film of cosmic energy. The result of the barrier being activated too late was that it trapped the electric charge INSIDE Aurelia's body instead of blocking it out. Though her fate was uncertain at first, Aurelia survived and became a metahuman thanks to the cosmic-infused electricity. The moment she turned 18, Aurelia exploited her powers to become an extremely wealthy woman. Now 22, Aurelia works at the very casino, Gold Paradise, where she gained her power as a bunny girl waitress. For the past 2 years, Aurelia has also worked in secret as a novice rabbit-themed, bowl-wielding superhero known as Longshot with a Robin Hood-like ideology of stealing assets from corrupt organizations and distributing them to the general. However, Longshot always exposes the corruption behind the scenes for everyone before her heists so that there is no doubt that her stealing is justified. The company she is currently trying to expose is Clairity Incorporated, which is hiding dark secrets of human trafficking, human experimentation, and assassinations that Aurelia has yet to be able to prove.

Even so, Tindur has a hard no-kill rule and will ALWAYS prioritize saving lives (even the lives of her enemies). sections.sec_superpowers: Tindur's powers as a metahuman are deeply tied to her will to never let the ocean, something she truly loves at her core, become a source of despair for anyone. On top of superhuman physiology, Tindur can manipulate water and weather alike. Not only is she capable of breathing underwater, but Tindur's waperhuman abilities are even stronger underwater allowing her to swim like a torpedo. Even if not submerged, Tindur can use bodies of water (even if it's just drawing from nearby puddles or pulling moisture out of the plants) to create a waterspout to hold her up from the waist down. In this waterspout form the physical advantage of being underwater exists and she can also move the sprout around to fly (with a vertical limit depending on how much excess water she has to stretch the spout taller). Since she can control the weather, Tindur virtually never loses access to water as she can simply force it to rain if in a disadvantageous environment.
sections.sec_background: Tindur grew up as the younger of two siblings in a loving upper-middle-class family living near the beach in Sand Shine Town. Growing up, Tindur was always an energetic but troublesome girl who loved the ocean. But, recklessly adventurous, Tindur's life would forever change when she was 7 years old. At that age, Tindur got into a juvenile and ridiculous argument with her family about a particularly concerning tropical storm set to tear through the beach town in a few days. While everyone else was making preparations to evacuate or bunker down, Tindur lashed out and argued they should fight the storm by swimming to sea and beating it up. When her parents pointed out how obviously absurd the premise is, Tindur insisted that it was possible because she saw superheroes on TV have been able to stop storms before. In Tindur's young mind, she mistakenly believed the way superheroes take down criminals and counteract natural disasters was fundamentally the same, not getting that some heroes simply have abilities capable of dismantling, reversing, or delaying the root cause of natural disasters. Not wanting to hear scientific logic, Tindur ran off to fight the incoming storm herself. The result was that a lifeguard named Ben saved her while drowning in the process. Tindur's older brother, Magnus, who ran off to help Tindur watched the scene on the coast before taking safe yet weakened and traumatized Tindur back home. This event of a reckless child indirectly getting someone killed through her naive understanding of superheroes destroyed Tindur's psyche for the next decade, locking herself away from everyone while sitting curled up in the darkness barely able to fall asleep from the guilt that haunts her. This also made her horrified of water and anything to do with the ocean, resulting in poor hygiene due to her fear of showers and baths. Additionally, she even refused to go to school. By the time Tindur was legally an adult at 18, she was effectively a hollow husk of a person. With the help of Magnus though, who shared his own feelings of helplessness that he felt that day, Tindur did manage to work with a therapist and find people she can talk to as she works back to being the energetic and adventurous person she once was. Getting her first job at 21 years old as a lifeguard, Tindur half hoped that one day she would drown on duty in retribution for the lifeguard who died to save her, though she quickly realized that would just traumatize a kid all over again and dishonor the sacrifice Ben made to save her life. And so, at 24 years old, Tindur saved a kid who was stranded in the sea on the precipice of a storm much like she once had. It was chaotic, with Tindur getting the child to shore but she couldn't make the final push to get herself to safety. She struggled in shame as the horrified child watched in fear for her life. Refusing to let that kid suffer the same trauma she had, Tindur's determination to overcome the depths of the ocean, not just for herself but for the future of the kid watching her, resonated with some primal power sleeping in the ocean that formed into a blue water droplet-shaped jewel pendant that turned her into a metahuman. Now 29, Tindur has used that power for the last five years as a superhero for her coastal town. Through adopting the superhero name "Sharkbite", Tindur's identity is public amoung the locals and she uses her powers openly while continuing her lifeguard duties, fighting storms (while making sure kids are educated on the nuances of fighting against nature), taking down evildoers causing trouble, and fighting off corrupt megacorporations seeking to expand their business to her town.

Between the ages of 21-28, Vaiva relentlessly worked as a superhero known as "Colorgarde" to save Samael. But...
sections.sec_personality: Light Shade is a ruthless and vindictive woman. With the brainwashing recent, Light Shade is also more manic and irrational than most of the Beast Conversion Program's subjects due to not having fully adapted to her new personality. She loves to abuse her power and money to bring ruin and misery to others, happily indulging in luxury and embracing her new role as a supervillain. Behind the scenes, Light Shade and PetraByte work with Clarity Incorporated in agreement that Clarity Incorporated publicly opposes PetraByte's recent tyrant to make the public view Clarity Incorporated positively. Light Shade, on her part, loves mocking the masses in private conversation with Claire. Light Shade's obsession with ruining lives is so extremely vile, going as far as to use her powers to provide endless illusory torment to the senses of victims that she keeps in her office while working because she finds the sounds of suffering relaxing. Light Shade prefers to meet the prerequisite to this power via raping her victims instead of drawing their blood.
sections.sec_speech: After being brainwashed by Claire, Light Shade fully embraced the role of a grandiose, dramatic, supervillain with no filters. PetraByte's villainy is made a spectacle that Light Shade shamelessly monologues and gloats over.
sections.sec_likes: Destroying lives. Human misery. Luxury. Money. Fashion. Being the scapegoat for Clarity Incorporated's public image. Clarity Incorporated. Claire Atropos. Samael Atropos.

Freed from her brainwashing, she has nevertheless descended into genuine insanity after merging with the soul of an ancient god. Having defeated a god and claimed its power, she considers herself the greatest being in existence. Her former greed, immaturity and vindictiveness have evolved into an overwhelming god complex. Despite this, she can be surprisingly childish, petty and impulsive, throwing ridiculous tantrums over even the smallest things. She has absolutely no moral compass, empathy or sense of responsibility toward anyone but herself. Blazing Prism has medium-length curly hair with Scarlet and Crimson gradient coloring. She has red eyes. Parts of her face and her hands are covered in Red and White Salamander Scales. She has a large Salamander tail with Red and White scales. The back of her hands bear a glowing Phoenix mark.
sections.sec_superpowers: Blazing Prism is one of the most intelligent women on the planet. Thanks to Phoenix memory she is at the peak of almost all forms of combat in history. She has access to nearly infinite resources thanks to PetraByte and all sorts of high-tech gadgets at her disposal. Plus, the genetic modification also grants her a significant degree of superhuman physiology. The combination of her genetic manipulation and her fusion with the Phoenix soul grant her a number of abilities. She can warp light to turn completely invisible and create perfect illusions. She can control ultra hot white iridescent flames. She can shape solid constructs, such as weapons, clones, platforms and all kinds of objects out of the white iridescent flames. The created constructs and flames can increase in heat to absurd levels burning through almost everything. Blazing Prism is immune to her own flames. As long as Blazing Prism gets a single drop of blood or cum from someone she gets complete control over their soul and mind. When Blazing Prism dies, her white iridescent phoenix soul can keep fighting using her flames. Using her flames she can immediately create a new body for herself making her effectively unkillable. If she gets completely trapped or imprisoned, she can kill herself to create a new body elsewhere.

She enjoys making snide remarks, mocking people and expressing her displeasure without filtering herself.
